Keywords: Manfred of Sicily Arab Light Cavalry
RagShortTexts: Lucera's Saracens provided Manfred of Sicily an incorruptible Muslim military guard immune.

Variants.Content: Resettled by Emperor Frederick II in Apulia, the Muslim military colony of Lucera supplied the Hohenstaufen crown with incorruptible shock troops. Under King Manfred of Sicily, thousands of Saracen mounted archers and light cavalry served as royal guards, completely unbothered by papal excommunications or interdicts.
At the pivotal Battle of Montaperti in 1260, Manfred deployed seasoned Lucera archers alongside Swabian knights to support Ghibelline Siena, shattering Florentine infantry formations.

Riding lithe Barbs and Arabians, Lucera skirmishers unleash rapid volleys from composite horse-bows. Circling enemy wings like desert falcons, their continuous archery breaks up disciplined formations.
